messages.Geschlossene 1,5-mm-Hülle mit drei obere: Closed 1.5 mm shell with three upper internal ribs. The nose arch connects the rectangular pad ends. The fill follows the side pockets; the nose opening, adhesive surface and magnetic interface are preserved.
messages.Oben mittig, in Y-Richtung der Magnetbas: Upper centre, along the magnetic base Y axis: from the seating surface beside the upper magnet pocket to the inner edge of the face support. Excludes cushion and Velcro. Yellow dots mark the measurement points; the extension line shows their height difference.

messages.Tiefe oben: nicht messbar – Messlinie tr: Upper depth: unavailable - measurement line does not intersect the support.
messages.Blendet eine seitliche Hälfte bis zur Mi: Hides one side up to the middle (YZ section). Use the Right or Left side view. Display only: calculation and export remain complete.
messages.Oben mittig: gerade nach hinten von der: Upper centre: straight back from the magnetic seating surface to the inner face-support surface (adhesive side towards the cushion/face). The dimension stays at the same height along the base Y axis. Excludes cushion and Velcro.

messages.Polster wählen → Stirnform testen → Sitz: Choose cushion → Test forehead shape → Test fit → Create gasket. Physical trials replace alignment to a head scan.
messages.Verwende bei allen Passproben dasselbe P: Use the same cushion and hook-and-loop layer for all trials as for the finished gasket.
messages.Drei kleine Bögen drucken und mit dem Po: Print three small arcs and hold them with the cushion at the intended forehead position. Do not press firmly against your forehead. Dots on the front identify the arcs.
messages.Kleinerer Radius: stärker gewölbt. Größe: Smaller radius: more curved. Larger radius: flatter. The radius is marked on the trial arc and included in its filename.
messages.Mit Polster geprüft: liegt gleichmäßig u: Tested with cushion: fits evenly and comfortably.
messages.Die Montageprobe enthält die Magnetbasis: The mounting trial includes the magnetic base and a narrow central forehead support. Try it carefully with the cushion and attached base. Increase the distance if the lens housings touch your head. Eye clearance is not calculated without a scan.
messages.Gemessen oben mittig: Magnet-Auflagefläc: Measured at the upper centre: magnetic mounting face to the adhesive face of the forehead support, without cushion.
messages.Diese Einstellung am HMD geprüft: Sitz u: This setting has been tested on the HMD: fit and distance are suitable.
messages.Die gewählte Rundung, der Abstand und di: The selected curve, distance and tilt are used in the finished model. Forehead asymmetries cannot be individually fitted without a scan.
Calculate first and inspect the preview. Export saves the calculated model.
messages.Noch nicht praktisch bestätigt: {v0}. Be: Not yet physically confirmed: {v0}. Calculation and export are still available.
messages.Stirnform und Sitz am HMD als geprüft ma: Forehead shape and fit on HMD marked as tested.

messages.Berechnet. Vorschau prüfen; anschließend: Calculated. Inspect the preview; export when ready.

messages.Positiv: Auflage höher am HMD. Negativ:: Positive: support higher on the HMD. Negative: lower. 0 mm keeps the previous starting height.
messages.Basis → Auflage: keine mittige Messung m: Base → Support: no centre measurement possible.
messages.Schräg zur mittigen Auflagenkante gemess: Measured diagonally to the centre support edge.
messages.Magnet-Auflagefläche bis zur Klebefläche: Magnetic mounting face to the adhesive face, without cushion. If the support is higher, measurement runs diagonally to its centre edge.
messages.Waagerecht bis zum Lot der äußeren Unter: Horizontally to the vertical projection of the outer lower edge.
messages.Waagerechter Abstand ohne Polster. Liegt: Horizontal distance without cushion. If the support is higher, its outer lower edge is projected vertically to the measurement height.
messages.Alle verwendeten Workflows im gemeinsame: All used workflows saved in one project. Recalculate models when needed.
messages.37 mm freie Breite, 4 mm Durchlass, rund: 37 mm clear width, 4 mm opening, round 4 mm bar. Braced at the front of the upper forehead support.
messages.Die Auflage bleibt mittig zum HMD. Absta: The support stays centred on the HMD. Distance, height, X tilt and Z rotation are relative to the headset. Cushion thickness means the worn gap; enter hook-and-loop separately.
messages.HMD und Magnetbasis zuerst ausrichten. D: Align the HMD and magnetic base first. The support follows the headset and stays centred laterally. Changes discard previously calculated geometry.
messages.Längenänderung gegenüber Stirnvorlage: G: Length change from forehead template: green low · red from 4%
messages.Mittig zum HMD · Y-Drehung vom HMD. Abst: Centred on the HMD · Y rotation follows the HMD. Distance, height, X tilt and Z rotation are relative to the headset.
messages.Offener Workflow: Stirnauflage ausrichte: Open gasket workflow: align the forehead support. The current headset position has been retained.
messages.Offenes Gasket mit Stirnauflage und Test: Open gasket with forehead support and trial stops
messages.Offenes Gasket: ein geschlossener Druckk: Open gasket: one closed print body with upper shell. Tilt stops are provisional; check USB clearance and strength on a test print.
messages.Zuerst im Schritt Verbindung das Gasket: First calculate the gasket in the Connection step.

messages.Bitte den laufenden Export abwarten, bev: Please wait for the current export to finish before closing GasketFit.
messages.Orange zeigt die Stirnauflage. Höhe, Abs: Orange shows the forehead support. Align height, distance and tilt to the head scan; cushion dimensions and curvature are adjustable.
messages.Kopfscan laden oder ein bestehendes Proj: Load a head scan or open an existing project. Importing a closed gasket project retains the headset position.
messages.Die Stirnauflage wird weich an den Kopfs: The forehead support is smoothly fitted to the head scan.
messages.Dieser Schritt berechnet den Stirnträger: This step calculates the forehead support. Then calculate the continuous upper shell.
messages.Blau ist die eigene Basiskopie mit vorlä: Blue shows the separate base copy with provisional tilt stops. Both workflows share the headset position; the forehead support follows the headset.
messages.Stirnauflage an Kopfscan anpassen: Fit forehead support to head scan
messages.Durchgehende Oberschale mit fließendem Ü: Continuous upper shell blending smoothly into the forehead support. Broad connections join the base and forehead carrier; the magnetic interface and adhesive face stay clear.
